description: SAR-Watch uses L-band radar data from the NASA-ISRO NISAR mission to detect and map Earth surface change, even through clouds and at night. I'm an RF/radar engineer (PhD, Northeastern) building an interactive before/after change map with simple "Radar 101" explanations of how microwaves see ice, soil, and forests. Looking for teammates skilled in Python, web apps, or data visualization who want to make radar science easy to understand.
